shell.welcomeBody: AEON turns SPHEREx-like 102-band survey data into discoveries: compare epochs, stack faint movers, read spectra and forecast orbits. Every number is computed; every synthetic object is labelled.

steps.title: Step 1 / 3 — WISE 0855−0714 (Coldest Brown Dwarf, 250 K)
steps.narration: Flying to WISE 0855 at 2.28 pc. In Image Differencing (Q2 vs Q4, both real SPHEREx visits), its 8.1″/yr proper motion reveals a clear negative/positive dipole separated by ~4″, while the 102-band spectrum highlights deep CH₄ (3.3 µm) and H₂O absorption.

steps.title: Step 2 / 3 — RW Aurigae (Young Variable T Tauri Star)
steps.narration: Flying to RW Aurigae. Scrubbing across 2026-Q1 through 2026-Q4 reveals strong 102-band continuum and circumstellar disk flux variations. Pin the Q1 spectrum as a reference to compare epochs directly.

steps.title: Step 3 / 3 — PX-2026-09 (Injected Synthetic Planet X Test Candidate, 520 AU)
steps.narration: Flying to synthetic test candidate PX-2026-09 (flagged is_synthetic: true). Invisible in single exposures (S/N < 3), Shift-and-Stack along 110″/yr, PA 62°, d = 520 AU boosts S/N > 6, fits its heliocentric orbit, and forecasts its 10-year arc with REBOUND IAS15.
